editorial.blurb: Hunan Gourmet delivers flavorful Chinese cuisine with generous portions and a skilled kitchen, anchored by private karaoke rooms perfect for group celebrations.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for dine-in rather than late-night pickup to enjoy dishes at proper temperature; the big round tables and private karaoke rooms are ideal for groups of 4–6, and parking is plentiful both in front and across the street.
